title: Ford's $30,000 EV Pickup Spotted in Public for First Time
detail: Ford's anticipated ~$30,000 entry-level electric pickup truck was photographed in the wild for the first time, offering the clearest public glimpse yet of the vehicle before its official launch. The sighting signals that the affordable electric truck segment — long promised but largely undelivered — is approaching a genuine launch window. Ford has been under pressure to offer a lower-cost EV pickup as rivals target mass-market buyers priced out of the Lightning.
